# te_hcg_save_targets (state scope): the hybrids of the host culture's language, for the hand-written pass
# (te_assimilation_culture_effects.txt). It reads scope:te_hc_host, a culture the pass saves first.
# The first roster language the host speaks whose first hybrid exists saves each of that language's
# hybrids as the temporary scope te_hc_t_<group> (te_hc_t_african ...) and sets the local variable
# te_hc_has_targets to 1. A host off the roster, or a game begun before the hybrids existed, sets nothing.
# A language has no hybrid for the one heritage group all its own cultures share, so its branch saves
# no scope for that group.
